guides.name: Graduate Research Scholarships
steps: Apply for a graduate research course at the University of Melbourne by the course application closing date.
Ensure your course application is complete, including all required documents.
You will be automatically considered for the scholarship; no separate application is necessary.
tips: Highlight your research potential and prior academic achievements in your course application.
Ensure all documents are accurate and submitted before the course application deadline.

guides.name: Research Training Program (RTP)
steps: Apply for a graduate research course at an Australian university participating in the RTP.
Ensure your course application includes all required documents.
You will be automatically considered for the RTP scholarship; no separate application is necessary.
tips: Emphasize your research experience and academic achievements in your course application.
Submit all documents accurately and before the course application deadline.

guides.name: Endeavour Postgraduate Scholarship
steps: Check the official Australian Government website for the Endeavour Postgraduate Scholarship application portal.
Prepare and submit your application by December 31, 2026.
Include all required documents in your application.
tips: Tailor your personal statement to reflect your career goals and how the scholarship aligns with them.
Obtain strong references that highlight your academic and professional capabilities.

guides.name: Monash University International Merit Scholarships
steps: Apply for a course at Monash University.
Complete the separate scholarship application form.
Submit all required documents with your scholarship application.
tips: Demonstrate your academic excellence and leadership qualities in your personal statement.
Ensure all documents are accurate and submitted before the scholarship application deadline.

guides.name: University of Sydney International Scholarships
steps: Apply for a postgraduate research degree at the University of Sydney.
Indicate your interest in the scholarship during your course application.
Submit all required documents with your course application.
tips: Highlight your research experience and potential in your application.
Ensure all documents are accurate and submitted before the course application deadline.
